annotations.text:
Monochrome glass redesign — no gradients, no decorative colour.
The only accent left is the map route line (routeAccent tweak, default #006CFF, the route's real GTFS colour).
Green appears once, as the 6px live-status dot.

Direction control: route 250 has two patterns, and the shipped timeline merges both — which is why its ETAs currently run 0,1,2,4…9 then fall back to 8,6,5. Swapping direction filters the timeline to one pattern.
Tokens, component states and both palettes side by side — the sheet to build styles.css from.
